# Read data
data <- read.csv("inputs/Swarm_2.csv")

# Parse Ratio to get proportion of strain 287
# For mixtures (287_98), ratio is like "1:3" meaning 287:98
# For pure strains, ratio is "1:0"

# Function to extract proportion of strain 287
get_prop_287 <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == "287") {
    return(1.0)  # pure 287
  } else if (strain == "98") {
    return(0.0)  # pure 98
  } else if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
  } else {
    return(NA)  # strain 1, not relevant
  }
}

data$prop_287 <- mapply(get_prop_287, data$StrainNumber, data$Ratio)

# Filter to relevant rows (exclude strain 1)
data_sub <- subset(data, !is.na(prop_287))

cat("Data used:\n")
print(data_sub[, c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "prop_287", "Area")])

# Fit models
# Quadratic
m_quad <- lm(Area ~ prop_287 + I(prop_287^2), data = data_sub)
# Cubic
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ prop_287 + I(prop_287^2) + I(prop_287^3), data = data_sub)
# Natural spline with df=4
library(splines)
m_ns <- lm(Area ~ ns(prop_287, df = 4), data = data_sub)

# Compare models using AIC
aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_ns <- AIC(m_ns)

cat("\nAIC values:\n")
cat(sprintf("Quadratic: %.2f\n", aic_quad))
cat(sprintf("Cubic: %.2f\n", aic_cubic))
cat(sprintf("Natural spline (df=4): %.2f\n", aic_ns))

# Also check adjusted R-squared
adj_r2_quad <- summary(m_quad)$adj.r.squared
adj_r2_cubic <- summary(m_cubic)$adj.r.squared
adj_r2_ns <- summary(m_ns)$adj.r.squared

cat("\nAdjusted R-squared:\n")
cat(sprintf("Quadratic: %.4f\n", adj_r2_quad))
cat(sprintf("Cubic: %.4f\n", adj_r2_cubic))
cat(sprintf("Natural spline (df=4): %.4f\n", adj_r2_ns))

# Determine best model by AIC (lowest)
models <- list(quad = m_quad, cubic = m_cubic, ns = m_ns)
aics <- c(quad = aic_quad, cubic = aic_cubic, ns = aic_ns)
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))
best_model <- models[[best_name]]

cat(sprintf("\nBest model by AIC: %s\n", best_name))

# Grid search for optimal proportion
grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.0001)
pred_df <- data.frame(prop_287 = grid)
preds <- predict(best_model, newdata = pred_df)

opt_idx <- which.max(preds)
opt_prop <- grid[opt_idx]
max_area <- preds[opt_idx]

cat(sprintf("\nOptimal proportion of strain 287: %.4f\n", opt_prop))
cat(sprintf("Maximum predicted colony area: %.2f\n", max_area))

# Also check with optimize for better precision
pred_func <- function(x) {
  newdata <- data.frame(prop_287 = x)
  predict(best_model, newdata = newdata)
}

opt <- optimize(pred_func, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("\nOptimize result:\n"))
cat(sprintf("Optimal proportion: %.6f\n", opt$maximum))
cat(sprintf("Maximum area: %.2f\n", opt$objective))

# Write answer
dir.create("codex_output", showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(round(opt$objective, 2)), "codex_output/answer.txt")
cat("\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt\n")
